gherkin.feature: OneStopShop Delete Compare list without popup
given: I am on the OneStopShop site
when:
Type "http://localhost:7770" on the url bar.
And click on "Enter".

Type "oneplus" on the search field.
Click on "Enter".

Click on the button "Add to Compare" for 1 item of the result page. (ex: "Rexin OnePlus 7 pro Warp Charger, 30W Power Adapter [5V 6A] + OnePlus USB-C Fast Charging Cable 1M / 3.3FT Data Cable for OnePlus7 6T 6 5T 5 ")

Click on the button "Add to Compare" for 1 item of the result page. (ex: [2-Pack] HPTech Tempered Glass for OnePlus 6T, OnePlus 6T McLaren and OnePlus 7 Screen Protector, Easy to Install, Bubble Free, 9H Hardness, Case Friendly )
On the left menu, Click on "Clear All".
then: The list is on the left menu is now empty.

gherkin_acceptance_criteria: The list is on the left menu is now empty.
